channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Police 'investigate Iran link' to suspected bomb plot at UK air base used by U.S.
item.description: U.K. counter-terrorism police are understood to be investigating a potential link with Iran after an alleged bomb threat against an air base hosting U.S. forces

item.title: Brent crude tops $107 as Trump rejects Iranian proposal to reopen Hormuz Strait
